intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for PipelineSubscriber. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Infrastructure subscription bean wiring the validated sample stream to ReorderHistoryService (source -> sink) as a Spring SmartLifecycle: start() subscribes sequentially, stop() disposes. This is the unit that places the History rule on the data path. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. No logger. Cover start/stop/isRunning on both branches (before start false, after start true, after stop false) and that a handle error does not terminate the subscription (next event still handled).

methods.semantics: Subscribes stream.events() -> concatMap(service.handle) once; a per-event error is swallowed with onErrorResume to Mono.empty() so the subscription survives.
Signal consumed by the Spring lifecycle: true while the subscription is active and not disposed; false before start and after stop.
